title: Y-MgNiSn Structure
comments:
This is the Y-phase of the Mg-Ni-Sn ternary system. The (2b), (4d) and (8e) Wyckoff positions are partially occupied and are represented by the labels M-I, M-II, and M-III, respectively. Here, M-I is Mg$_{0.88}$Ni$_{0.12}$, which we label ``Ni'', M-II is Sn$_{0.88}$Mg$_{0.12}$ labeled ``Sn'', and M-III is Mg$_{0.95}$Ni$_{0.05}$, labeled ``Ni'', with the supposed element names picked to highlight the different Wyckoff positions. 
 We previously referred to this as the $\gamma$-phase, but Y-phase is the proper terminology (Boudard, 2004).
